challenges.title: Learning to Tattoo
challenges.goal: Dedicate 100 hours to learning tattoo techniques, starting from zero experience.
challenges.description: I can't draw, I have absolutely no experience, and I have decided that learning how to tattoo is a perfectly reasonable idea. Let's see what happens after 100 hours.

sessions.did: I started by learning some technical terms and the main tattoo styles.
sessions.notes: None of the main styles reflects the one I would like to adopt.
